prompts.description:
Analiza todos los cambios del repo, propone el plan de commits siguiendo
Conventional Commits y espera confirmación del usuario antes de ejecutar.
prompts.name: best_practice_commits

prompts.description: Review a pull request: diff, context, checks, and review comments.
prompts.name: code_review

prompts.description:
Amend the last commit: fix the message and/or add forgotten staged files.

Use this when you just committed and realized the message is wrong or you
forgot to stage a file. Do NOT use on commits already pushed to a shared branch.
prompts.name: commit_amend

prompts.description: Clean up commit history before opening a PR: squash WIP commits, fix messages.
prompts.name: commit_history_cleanup

prompts.description:
Craft and apply a Conventional Commit following the CC spec (conventionalcommits.org).

Inspects staged changes, validates the commit message, and calls git_commit.
prompts.name: conventional_commit

prompts.description: Diagnose and fix a failing GitHub Actions workflow run.
prompts.name: debug_ci_failure

prompts.description: Plan and execute a safe backport workflow.
prompts.name: git_backport_workflow

prompts.description: Split current changes into an explicit multi-commit plan.
prompts.name: git_multi_commit_workflow

prompts.description: Plan and execute a stacked PR workflow safely.
prompts.name: git_stacked_pr_workflow

prompts.description: Manage, integrate, and merge multiple worktree tasks safely.
prompts.name: git_worktree_parallel_merge_workflow

prompts.description: Health check for multiple side-by-side git repositories.
prompts.name: multi_repo_health

prompts.description: AI-agent guide for parallel git worktree development and integration.
prompts.name: parallel_worktree_workflow

prompts.description:
Complete flow to create a well-structured GitHub Pull Request.

Checks branch state, cleans commit history, writes the PR body from the
diff, and calls gh_pr_create with a conventional title.
prompts.name: pr_create_flow

prompts.description: Manage a stack of dependent Pull Requests (stacked PRs / PR chains).
prompts.name: pr_stack

prompts.description: Prepare and publish a new release.
prompts.name: release_workflow

prompts.description:
Isolate a single feature in its own git worktree (simpler than parallel workflow).

Creates one worktree for focused work, then integrates via a PR.
Use this for a single self-contained feature. For N parallel tasks use
the `parallel_worktree_workflow` prompt instead.
prompts.name: worktree_feature

prompts.description:
Emergency hotfix in an isolated worktree — minimal blast radius, fast turnaround.

Creates a `hotfix/<name>` branch from `base_branch`, applies the fix in an
isolated worktree, and opens a PR. Does NOT touch the main checkout.
prompts.name: worktree_hotfix
